## 阻塞发现

- `CRITICAL` 首个 `qualification-fixture grant` / 首个 `production default grant` 仍然没有可执行的签发者，导致 vNext 第一次上线无法从 provisional 走到 trusted。

```685:690:docs/plans/vnext-durable-autonomy-architecture.md
qualification-fixture grant is short-lived, signed by the previous trusted
supervisor, and binds one external runner, project/checkout, execution cell,
candidate release, fault manifest and test purpose. It may exercise the full
terminal path only inside that disposable runner so C2/D2 can test the path
before a production grant exists; `canCount*` rejects it in every production
audience. The resulting soak report can support a new production grant, but the
```

```1889:1891:docs/plans/vnext-durable-autonomy-architecture.md
Default activation is an append-only capability grant written
by the previous trusted supervisor for exactly one
execution-cell/release-artifact/backend-package/supervisor/fault-manifest tuple.
```

攻击路径：C2 要跑完整 terminal path，先要 `qualification-fixture grant`；D2 要激活首个生产 cell，又要求 `production default grant` 由 “previous trusted supervisor” 写入。但计划把 bootstrap 例外只写到了 “first A0 migration only”，没有把“首个 fixture grant / 首个 production grant”也纳入引导闭环。结果是：没有上一个 trusted supervisor，就没人能合法签第一张票；没有第一张票，就永远到不了第一个 trusted release。这是标准的不可交付依赖闭环。

最小修正：显式增加一次性 bootstrap grant 机制，覆盖“首个 fixture grant”和“首个 production default grant”，并把签发者、对象绑定、撤销、审计材料、失效条件写成和 A0 bootstrap 同等级的受控例外；或者定义一个经外部批准的“bootstrap supervisor”能承担这两个首发签发动作。

- `P1` 计划只为 `GoalComplete` 定义了 canonical trusted read，没有同等级的 task-current 读取策略；因此 `TaskDone` 仍可被 same-tree / different-commit 替换后继续当成当前真值使用。

```1255:1266:docs/plans/vnext-durable-autonomy-architecture.md
Git recovery and task-terminal recovery are separate aggregates. A task in
`GitBoundUntrusted` with an exact `kernel-bound` saga maps to the one task action
`evaluate-terminal-policy`, even though the Git saga itself maps to `noop`.
That action re-observes the current contract, Git identity, approval/key state,
effective capability and proof dependencies: current C1 predicates with an
incomplete C2/default grant atomically produce `TaskDoneProvisional`, while all
current `full-trusted` predicates produce `TaskDone`;
stale/revoked predicates produce `TaskProofStale`; temporarily missing evidence
leaves `GitBoundUntrusted` with a typed `terminal-evidence-pending` reason and a
bounded retry. `TaskDoneProvisional` maps back to
`evaluate-terminal-policy`, `TaskDone` maps to `noop`, while `TaskProofStale` requires a new
```

```1376:1383:docs/plans/vnext-durable-autonomy-architecture.md
One `canCountGoalCompletion()` policy is the only trusted read. Cockpit, MCP,
observe, release, publish, approval and every `GoalComplete` projection call it
instead of inspecting `status`. It re-observes the exact ref/commit/tree and config
bytes, then transactionally compares current contract/intent, authority epoch,
constraint catalog/snapshot, policy, trust closure, receipt/waiver revocation
facts, approval/key revocation facts, archive anchors and per-gate calibration state through the dependency
index, including current backend qualification and exact-cell default grant.
```

攻击路径：任务在提交 `T1` 上达到 `TaskDone` 后，分支又被替换为 `T2`（树相同但 commit/parent 不同，或 ref 漂移）。计划对 `GoalComplete` 有 `canCountGoalCompletion()` 和 `C1-GOAL-01`，但没有 task 级别的 `canCountTaskCompletion()`，也没有 task 级 same-tree replacement fault row。于是 `TaskDone` 一旦写成就 `noop`，下游依赖调度、cycle close、或任何把任务状态当当前真值的读取面，都可能继续接受一个已不再绑定当前 Git 对象的“旧真值”。

最小修正：增加 task 级 canonical read / canonical projection 规则，要求所有“当前任务已完成”的信任读取都重验 exact ref/commit/tree、task contract、approval/key、receipt/calibration/default grant；并新增 task 级 ref/commit/tree drift 与 same-tree commit replacement 失效路径，把 `TaskDone -> TaskProofStale` 明确纳入 dependency invalidation 和 fault annex。

- `P1` Node 20 的支持声明仍然自相矛盾，属于不诚实兼容性边界。

```40:43:docs/plans/vnext-durable-autonomy-architecture.md
- Node.js `>=20`, current CLI names, protocol fixtures, initialized projects,
  templates, and legacy JSON read compatibility remain supported. EOL Node lines
  retain legacy/manual compatibility but cannot claim trusted unattended
  operation. Legacy writers become unsupported after an explicit SQLite
```

```975:977:docs/plans/vnext-durable-autonomy-architecture.md
grant and current calibrations for `full-trusted`. Node 20 is hard-capped at
`legacy-json-manual` before cutover and `read-only-diagnosis` after cutover,
regardless of whether a native module happens to load.
```

当前仓库也仍公开声明：

```61:63:package.json
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20"
  },
```

攻击路径：操作者根据顶层承诺理解为“Node >=20 受支持，EOL 线至少还有 manual/legacy 能力”；但仓库一旦 cutover，Node 20 就被直接降为 `read-only-diagnosis`，连 post-cutover 的 manual 路径都没有。这不是“trusted 能力被收紧”，而是顶层支持语义与后文运行语义冲突，会让支持声明高估真实可操作边界。

最小修正：二选一。要么把顶层承诺收窄成“post-cutover only maintained Node lines are operational；Node 20 is read-only after cutover”；要么明确设计并验证一个真正存在的 Node 20 `protected-json-manual` 路径。

## P2 备注

- `P2` 现有仓库里的计划评审实现仍保留 `dryRun => passed: true` 的老路径；计划文本已经把 bootstrap authority 外移了，但落地时必须明确禁止任何 legacy `plan-review.json` 或 dry-run 结果被当成授权信号。

```132:142:scripts/lib/plan-review.mjs
  if (dryRun) {
    return {
      planHash,
      runId,
      reviewedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      reviewer: "dry-run",
      command: reviewCommand,
      findings: { critical: [], warning: [], suggestion: [] },
      passed: true,
      dryRun: true,
    };
  }
```

- `P2` 当前仓库仍大量依赖文件级持久化与直接 writer（如 `scripts/lib/orchestration-state.mjs`、`scripts/lib/pilot-state.mjs`）；这不构成逻辑性 blocker，因为计划已把 writer inventory 作为 A0/A2 核心交付，但意味着 A0 范围控制必须非常严格，否则容易从“逻辑正确”滑成“实现面漏洞”。

## 假设与结论
我按“false-success / trust adversary”角度审查，并把“下游只要还有任何路径会把旧的 trusted task state 当当前真值”视为阻塞。若作者的真实意图是“任务级 trusted state 从不复用，唯一 current truth 只有 goal attestation”，那第二条可以降级；但目前文本并没有这么写，且 delivery graph 仍把 `TaskDone` 作为显式可信状态。
